name: ui/card
title: Card
summary: The registry card: the card surface (14px radius, hairline ring), default or sm, with a built-in loading skeleton. Header, title, description, action, content and footer are its parts.

props.name: size
props.description: sm tightens the gap and padding.

props.name: loading
props.description: Renders its own skeleton instead of the content.

slots.name: default
slots.description: The content: usually the header, content and footer parts.

behaviour: While loading, the content is not rendered: three muted bars pulse in its place.
data-size carries the size so the parts can tighten with it.

keyboard: None: a surface, not a control.
aria: None: the content carries its own semantics.

theming.brandOverlay: None: the card surface is the same in every brand.

noJs.without: Everything: the component is server-rendered HTML with no script.

contract:
contract
  slot is "card"
  class contains "bg-card"
  class contains "rounded-[var(--radius-lg,14px)]"
  when default shows div "Body"
  when sm slot is "card"
  when loading class contains "animate-pulse"
end
